plan.rationale: I stripped away all traditional academic padding to focus exclusively on the candidate's ability to ship high-agency, reliable AI systems. The founder wants to see 'quality of mind' and 'commercial judgment,' so I prioritized projects that demonstrate end-to-end ownership—specifically those where the candidate built his own guardrails, verification layers, and on-device pipelines. I benched all credentials and non-technical positions to respect the founder's explicit constraints. The resulting narrative frames the candidate not as a student, but as a builder who treats every project as a production-grade system, directly addressing the 'Professional Vibe Coder' requirement.
